Fraudster turned writer Matthew Cox tells Danny Jones that Robert Mueller buried the FBI's role in a murder conspiracy. Cox, a former mortgage fraud kingpin who served years in prison, now reports on cases from inside knowledge of the system. His charge against the former FBI director is dark and specific.

Cox walks through the case and the informant ties he says the bureau hid. He argues Mueller's office protected its own people at the cost of justice. Jones asks what documents back the claim and what remains unproven. Skeptical and brave listeners get a whistleblower's story from an unlikely source.
